concept: Envision Dance pairs a vibrant fuchsia primary with a graceful violet secondary and a soft gold accent, set against airy off-white backgrounds and grounded by deep plum ink. The palette feels energetic, elegant, joyful, and encouraging - the spin of a fuchsia skirt under warm stage light.
contrastNotes: All required pairs pass WCAG-AA. ink #2A1226 on bg #FBF6FA = 16.21:1 (>=7); ink-soft #6E3A63 on bg = 8.03:1 (>=4.5); white on primary #B5179E = 5.86:1 (>=4.5); primary on bg = 5.49:1 (>=3). Extras: white on primary-dark #8A0F77 = 8.69:1 and white on secondary #7B2CBF = 7.11:1 (both safe for buttons/text); ink on surface = 17.31:1, ink on surface-alt = 14.65:1. Soft gold accent #C8901A is decorative (2.64:1 on bg) and must not be used for body text - pair with ink for labels.
